meta.notes: Magic abilities are unlocked through shelving progress rather than Robux purchases. Each ability speeds up part of the find-carry-shelve loop. Cards show the ability name, what it does, and how it is unlocked. Per-ability menu icons are not reliably available without in-game capture, so the catalog launches image-light.

items.name: Assemble
items.effect: Gathers loose books together so you can pick up a batch at once instead of one book at a time.
items.cardSummary: Assemble pulls scattered books into a group, letting you collect a stack in one go rather than chasing each book.

items.name: Sort
items.effect: Arranges the books you are holding into order so they are quicker to shelve.
items.cardSummary: Sort organizes your held books for you, cutting the manual sorting you would otherwise do before each shelf run.

items.name: Insight
items.effect: Reveals where books belong so you spend less time figuring out the right shelf.
items.cardSummary: Insight points you toward the correct shelf for your books, taking the guesswork out of sorting.

items.name: Shelf Guide
items.effect: Highlights the shelf a book belongs on so you can drop it off directly.
items.cardSummary: Shelf Guide marks the destination shelf for a book, so you can head straight to it instead of searching.

items.name: Auto-Shelving
items.effect: Shelves books automatically, handling part of the sorting work for you.
items.cardSummary: Auto-Shelving places books on their shelves on its own, freeing you to keep collecting while sorting happens for you.
